descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Turn your surroundings into a lively world of magical critters!

In Critter Blitz, adorable creatures scamper across the ground and flutter through the air all around you. Grab your net, take aim, and catch as many as you can before the expedition ends.

Every successful catch earns coins and helps you rise through the ranks. Discover rare critters, unlock the powerful Net Launcher, and get ready for the arrival of an enormous critter that will put your catching skills to the test!

Each new discovery is added to your CritterDex. Keep exploring, complete your collection, improve your score, and choose a cute nickname to claim your place on the leaderboard.

With colorful critters, simple controls, cheerful guidance, and quick play sessions, Critter Blitz is a family-friendly mixed reality adventure that is easy to pick up and fun to master.

Features:

• Catch charming critters on the ground and in the air
• Discover rare creatures and encounter enormous critters
• Earn coins and progress through ten ranks
• Unlock the Net Launcher and expand your catching abilities
• Fill your CritterDex with every new discovery
• Compete for a place on the leaderboard
• Enjoy colorful, family-friendly mixed reality gameplay
